    M = inputs['M']
    power = inputs['power']
    mod = inputs['mod']
    result = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]  # Identity matrix
    while power > 0:
        if (power % 2) == 1:  # If power is odd, multiply the base with result
            result = [[(result[0][0]*M[0][0] + result[0][1]*M[1][0]) % mod, (result[0][0]*M[0][1] + result[0][1]*M[1][1]) % mod],
                      [(result[1][0]*M[0][0] + result[1][1]*M[1][0]) % mod, (result[1][0]*M[0][1] + result[1][1]*M[1][1]) % mod]]
        M = [[(M[0][0]*M[0][0] + M[0][1]*M[1][0]) % mod, (M[0][0]*M[0][1] + M[0][1]*M[1][1]) % mod],  # Square the base
             [(M[1][0]*M[0][0] + M[1][1]*M[1][0]) % mod, (M[1][0]*M[0][1] + M[1][1]*M[1][1]) % mod]]
        power = power // 2
    return sum(map(sum, result))
